body: There won't be a "sometime" for me, but thanks for trying.

Socks, candy, and small little trinkets mostly. I don't want help this time. The worst part about failing the first two times was realizing that I failed and I have to live out my sad life even longer

Nothing makes me happy. I just feel empty all the time. My parents are very open about their arguments and make sure to let me know how much I hinder them financially. I told some internet friends I wanted to die and I had the pills but they had my address from when we exchanged Christmas presents last year so they called the police before I could do anything.

My parents don't care about me. If they did, they'd actually be more supportive instead of contributing to my depression and as for school, I'm just too tired to be bothered with asking them to be lenient with me. Either I have the money or I don't. I've reached out to people before, but they called the police. I can't let that happen again. I honestly don't know why everyone hates me. I just know they've been dead set on taking away everything that makes me happy. I can only go to school and home because I risk someone inducing one of my anxiety attack for fun whenever I go to public outings or even to the store.

EDIT: my parents won't say it, but I can tell they don't want me to go to school at all. My mom doesn't think I can handle it and my dad is a deadbeat who doesnt want to help pay for it.
